# Ib Rasmussen

Ib Rasmussen is a senior consultant physician (overlæge) at Klinik Psykiatri Syd, part of Aalborg Universitetshospital in Region Nordjylland [^src1][^src2]. He is a member of the steering committee for the ADHD-databasen (the ADHD Database), a Danish national health quality database that monitors the diagnostic assessment and treatment of ADHD in children and young people under 18 [^src1][^src2].

Rasmussen appears in the annual reports of the ADHD-databasen for both 2023 and 2024, where steering committee members are listed alongside their institutional affiliations [^src1][^src2]. In the 2024 report he is additionally identified as a member of Dansk Psykiatrisk Selskab (the Danish Psychiatric Society) [^src2]. The steering committee he sits on draws members from senior consultants, specialist physicians, psychologists, nurses, epidemiologists, and relative/patient representatives from across Denmark, and is tasked with overseeing data on ADHD assessment and treatment populations, including breakdowns by age, sex, and region, as well as findings such as the notably lower rate of children with ADHD passing the Danish lower-secondary school leaving exam (folkeskolens afgangsprøve) before age 17 compared to the general population [^src1]. In the 2024/2025 edition of the database's steering group material, membership is described as representing all five Danish regions, professional societies, patient organisations, and the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) [^src2].

Rasmussen's institutional home, [[klinik-psykiatri-syd-aalborg|Klinik Psykiatri Syd, Aalborg Universitetshospital]], situates him within Region Nordjylland's psychiatric services, and his committee role connects him to the broader national effort — coordinated through the ADHD-databasen — to track quality of care for children and adolescents with ADHD across Denmark [^src1][^src2].
